messages:
leah: Quick sync — follow-up from the multiplexer RFC. We need a thinner contract for panel-level query multiplexing + RBAC enforcement. Also thinking about operational fallback paths. Raising for visibility.
omar: Can we move auth checks to the router instead of the multiplexer? Simpler surface area if router validates first.
jun: Router-first sounds simple but duplicates batch keys and reduces effective batching. Multiplexer-first preserves batching but forces auth token propagation and more complex auth logic inside mux. Tradeoff: throughput vs code surface.
ops-bot: FYI deploy window open 2026-03-02 02:00-04:00 UTC for experimental rollout (per runbook).
sam: Proposal: two-layer contract. Router -> Mux: send an opaque envelope with minimal headers. Mux -> Store: use a resolved, authenticated envelope. That lets router do cheap checks and short-circuits, while mux owns final auth decisions for batch groups.
nina: Concern: header leakage when routing across regions/clusters. We need explicit redaction + sensitivity flags on headers so logging doesn't leak tenant ids.
carla: Ops note: if auth lives in mux, KV and response caches must include tenant scope in keys to avoid cross-tenant cache hits. Also think about cache pinning when a tenant rolls out new model versions.
leah: Sketch of config we can iterate on (very rough):
```json
{
  "router_to_mux": {
    "contract_version": "v1",
    "headers_allowed": ["x-tenant-id", "x-auth-hash", "x-request-id"],
    "sensitivity": {"x-tenant-id": "redact"},
    "auth_mode": "router|mux" /* feature-flag toggle */
  }
}
```
jun: Also need clear SLO delineation per stage. Router must not block on mux backpressure; implement a fast-fallback path that returns cached projection + a stale flag.
omar: Ops question: rollback criteria for canary? Proposed: latency increase >25ms or error rate >1% per route.
ops-bot: Canary policy configured: auto-abort on 20% error rate or p95 latency +40ms sustained for >5 minutes.
sam: Add these observability metrics before rollout: mux.batch_size, mux.auth_fail_count, mux.tenant_cache_miss, router_fallback_count, mux.queue_depth.
nina: Also add header-level tagging so logging pipeline redacts keys with sensitivity=redact.
carla: Implementation plan: 1) add interface shim + feature flag (router->mux), 2) small canary in qa region, 3) wire metrics + alerts, 4) ramp to 20% then 50% traffic if stable.
leah: I'll open an RFC follow-up doc + PR with the shim diff and basic tests today. tagging @ops for the rollout window and @jun @sam for review. :rocket:
